annotation_criterion: A budget is relevant if at least two of its components would serve as a credible effort reference for parts of the requested project (described in enough detail to estimate from). Annotated from the budget content alone, without looking at what the system retrieves.

queries.query: Loan application platform with automatic credit scoring, KYC checks and electronic contract signing
queries.notes: Only 2024-002 covers scoring, KYC origination workflow and e-signature. Other finance budgets (001, 003, 004, 016) share the sector but not the components.

queries.query: Online store checkout with card payments, order management and refunds
queries.notes: 005 has the cart and checkout service and 006 the split orders and refund handling. 003 (payments gateway) is the distractor: close in the vector space, useless to estimate a store. 017 has cart and checkout, but as one-line tickets, too thin to be an effort reference.

queries.query: Integrate our patient records with the hospital EHR using HL7 FHIR R4, with patient consent and access audit
queries.notes: Only 2024-009 has the FHIR integration layer plus the consent and audit module. 012 (clinical trials) handles patient data but not FHIR.

queries.query: A tool that tells the plant which machines are about to break down so repairs can be planned in advance
queries.notes: 2024-013 covers sensor ingestion, predictive maintenance models and the SCADA dashboard overlay. 010 raises alerts on patient vitals, 015 forecasts grid load: different domains.

queries.type: long and messy, like a meeting transcript
queries.query: So the client runs a few warehouses, they need to know what is in stock and where, pick orders with barcode scanners, they also have robots carrying pallets around and want the trucks to book a dock slot
queries.notes: Only 2024-014 covers warehouse core, AGV coordination and dock scheduling. 007 (grocery delivery) has inventory sync and routing but no warehouse operations.
